title: White-label ML/AI engineering partner
buyer: Software development firms, data consultancies and cloud systems integrators
problem: A contracted customer needs specialist AI skills the agency lacks or cannot staff quickly
outcome: Agreed AI work package delivered behind or alongside the agency
qualify: Do you have an active funded AI work package?
What is the required role and delivery milestone?
Who owns acceptance and payment?
proof: Independently created technical implementation examples with tests
metric: Milestone accepted against written technical criteria
risk: White-label permissions, confidential material, scope and ownership

title: Controlled AI workflow automation
problem: High manual load and approval delays for documents or business decisions
outcome: Measurable step-level automation with human approval gates
qualify: What is the current process volume and baseline turnaround?
Which steps require human authorization?
What applications and data interfaces exist?
proof: Synthetic approval/document validation demo and audit trace
metric: Cycle time, intervention rate, exception and policy accuracy

title: Private enterprise knowledge retrieval
problem: Staff cannot reliably find answers across fragmented documents
outcome: Permission-aware retrieval experience with citations and repeatable evaluation
qualify: What document types and update frequency?
Which users can access which knowledge?
What benchmark questions exist?
proof: Hybrid retrieval evaluation demo with source-linked answers
metric: Grounded answer correctness, retrieval recall, latency and access-control tests
risk: Wrong sources, leakage and stale documents

title: Forecasting, risk and classification models
buyer: Fintech, operations, retail and data teams
problem: Expensive decisions made without calibrated predictions
outcome: Evaluated, reproducible predictive model plus integration design
qualify: What target and business decision does the score affect?
How many labeled records and what leakage risks?
What are the costs of false positives and negatives?
proof: Leakage-audited synthetic fraud or demand forecasting case study
metric: PR-AUC, calibration, business-weighted cost, time-split drift
risk: Leakage, class imbalance, dataset shift and model misuse

title: Computer vision detection and inspection
buyer: Manufacturers, safety integrators, computer vision product teams
problem: Manual inspection is costly, slow or inconsistent
outcome: Vision model validated against representative deployment conditions
qualify: Can you provide representative and labeled imagery?
What device, lighting and latency constraints exist?
What false-detection rate is tolerable?
proof: Object detection demonstration with per-class evaluation and visual error cases
metric: Precision, recall, false alarms, robustness and device latency
risk: Data coverage, labeling cost and domain shift

title: Structured document extraction and validation
buyer: Finance, procurement, operations and compliance teams
problem: Manual reading and data entry from documents wastes employee time
outcome: Structured extraction and exception processing with review interface
qualify: Which document formats and fields?
What existing validation rules and APIs?
What is the cost of an incorrect extraction?
proof: Synthetic invoice/receipt extraction and validation demo
metric: Field-level accuracy, exception review rate and processing cost
risk: Handwriting, unseen formats and personal information

title: LLM/RAG production evaluation and reliability review
problem: Quality is unreliable or model/tooling changes break production workflows
outcome: Evaluation harness, failure taxonomy, regression tests and release gates
qualify: What is the current baseline and failure cost?
Are production traces or gold labels available?
What model versions and deployment pipeline are used?
proof: Retrieval and response quality harness with traceable test cases
metric: Groundedness, task success, safety failures, regression rate and p95 latency
risk: Unrepresentative evaluation samples and mislabeled feedback

title: Model inference and serving optimization
problem: Model inference latency or infrastructure spend makes deployment difficult
outcome: Benchmarked serving configuration and rollout recommendations
qualify: What is the p95 latency and throughput target?
Which model and hardware are available?
Which fidelity trade-offs are permissible?
proof: Reproducible serving benchmark and load test
metric: p95 latency, throughput, per-request compute cost, error rate
risk: Benchmark mismatch and quality degradation from optimization

title: Customer propensity and marketing decision support
buyer: E-commerce firms and marketing analytics agencies
problem: Campaign targeting and conversion prioritization are inefficient
outcome: Propensity segmentation with validated economics and explanatory features
qualify: Which event and outcome data exists?
What decision will change using the score?
Can you run a randomized uplift validation?
proof: Public/synthetic propensity model with SHAP and lift metrics
metric: Calibrated uplift, campaign ROI and incremental conversion
risk: Selection bias and mistaking correlation for uplift

title: Production AI data readiness and MLOps pipelines
buyer: Data teams building ML or GenAI products
problem: Inconsistent data pipelines impede safe deployment and retraining
outcome: Versioned ingestion, validation, features and deployment automation
qualify: What source systems and update cadence?
What are present freshness and data quality failures?
Which deployment and observability requirements apply?
proof: Incremental batch pipeline and reproducible model evaluation demo
metric: Data freshness, data quality failures, reproducibility and deployment time
risk: Schema drift, lineage errors and non-idempotent ingestion
